name: High Knees
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Begin running in place, lifting your knees as high as possible.
Aim to bring your knees up to hip level or higher with each step.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs, keeping elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Land on the balls of your feet to maintain a quick, light pace.
Keep your core engaged and maintain an upright posture throughout.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
